sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Overall market breadth remains exceptionally narrow with only Healthcare posting positive performance across all timeframes, while Energy and Technology hold firm as the primary momentum leaders.

Leadership remains concentrated at the top. Energy commands the market with a momentum score of 0.833 and a #1 YTD rank, followed closely by sustained strength in Technology (momentum 0.783, YTD rank 2). Meanwhile, Healthcare represents the sole pocket of total structural breadth, registering as the only all-green sector across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD horizons with a 0.700 momentum score.

Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors continue to lag. Utilities and Real Estate occupy the basement with matching momentum scores of 0.217 (YTD ranks 10 and 8, respectively), while Consumer Cyclical sits at the absolute bottom of the rankings (rank 11, momentum 0.383). Sector positioning over the last five sessions shows zero rank movement across the board, reflecting a rigid, frozen hierarchy rather than active rotation.

## Strength
- **Narrow Structural Breadth:** Only 1 of 11 groups qualifies as all-green across all evaluated periods (Healthcare, momentum 0.700).
- **Persistent Tech Leadership:** Technology exhibits sustained strength, retaining top-3 placement across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons with a 0.783 momentum score.
- **Top Momentum Tier:** Energy leads the entire complex with a 0.833 momentum score and a #1 YTD rank.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Momentum Leaders:** Energy (0.833), Technology (0.783), Healthcare (0.700), and Consumer Defensive (0.617) round out the strongest groups.
- **Momentum Laggards:** Utilities (0.217) and Real Estate (0.217) are tied as the weakest momentum sectors, followed by Financials (0.367) and Consumer Cyclical (0.383).
- **Stalled Positional Shifts:** No sector recorded a rank change over the past 5 sessions, with top gainers and losers all registering net-zero movement.

## Divergences
- **Industrials Rank vs. Momentum Disconnect:** Industrials carries a relatively high YTD rank of 4 despite a weak momentum score of 0.400, placing it among the bottom five momentum laggards.
- **Healthcare Breadth Outpacing Rank:** Healthcare is the only group green across all timeframes, yet its YTD rank sits at 5, trailing Energy (rank 1) and Technology (rank 2).
- **Absence of Fragile Leaders:** No valid all-green sectors currently trigger instability or rank-agreement divergence warnings.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and infrastructure tech maintain top-tier momentum, while housing and real estate groups suffer sharp weekly rank deteriorations.

Leadership remains anchored by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.992, rank 1 YTD) and Communication Equipment (momentum 0.924, rank 5 YTD), forming the core of 21 all-green groups displaying positive returns across all timeframes. Defensive and consumer staples pockets are rotating upward, with Tobacco leaping 18 spots to rank 31 alongside solid 5-day gains in Beverages - Brewers (+13 spots) and Discount Stores (+13 spots).

Conversely, real estate and building-exposed industries are fading fast. Telecom Services tumbled 22 spots, joined by acute drops in Lumber & Wood Production (-15 spots), Real Estate - Development (-14 spots), Residential Construction (-13 spots), and REIT - Office (-12 spots). Meanwhile, rate-sensitive groups like Mortgage Finance (0.034 momentum) and REIT - Mortgage (0.063 momentum) stay pinned at the bottom of the rankings.

## Strength
- **High-Momentum Leaders:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.992 momentum, rank 1 YTD), Communication Equipment (0.924 momentum, rank 5 YTD), and Copper (0.853 momentum, rank 9 YTD) lead the market's 21 all-green industries.
- **Sustained Performers:** Software - Infrastructure (0.841 momentum) and Health Information Services (0.838 momentum) continue to demonstrate durable strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Defensive Anchors:** Tobacco (0.84 momentum) and Oil & Gas Integrated (0.83 momentum) maintain all-green profiles with unbroken positive returns across weekly through YTD windows.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Rank Gainers:** Tobacco surged +18 spots (rank 31, 0.84 momentum), followed by +13 spot jumps from Beverages - Brewers (rank 34), Internet Retail (rank 65), Discount Stores (rank 66), and Utilities - Regulated Water (rank 47).
- **Severe Short-Term Slips:** Telecom Services dropped -22 spots to rank 118 (0.13 momentum), Shell Companies slid -21 spots to rank 50, and Lumber & Wood Production fell -15 spots to rank 89.
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.034 momentum, rank 142 YTD), REIT - Mortgage (0.063 momentum, rank 134 YTD), and Recreational Vehicles (0.065 momentum, rank 137 YTD) anchor the bottom tier.

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Shell Companies dropped 21 spots over 5 days despite a 0.60 momentum score, while Department Stores (0.73 momentum) and Internet Content & Information (0.72 momentum) also slipped in rank (-4 and -3 spots, respectively).
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Consulting Services gained 9 rank spots in 5 sessions despite weak momentum (0.38), alongside rank improvements in Confectioners (+8 spots, 0.50 momentum) and Utilities - Diversified (+7 spots, 0.44 momentum).
